parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: Settings for paging query. The page number of the current page. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description:
The unique ID of the data object to query.

> You can call [DescribeDataObjects](~~2399253~~) to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh_cn**. Valid values:
- **zh_cn**: Chinese.
- **en_us**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Settings for paging query. The maximum number of data asset instances to display on each page. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: ProductId
parameters.description:
The ID of the product to which the data object belongs. Valid values:
- **1**: MaxCompute
- **2**: OSS
- **3**: ADB-MYSQL
- **4**: TableStore
- **5**: RDS
- **6**: SELF_DB
- **7**: PolarDB-X
- **8**: PolarDB
- **9**: ADB-PG
- **10**: OceanBase
- **11**: MongoDB
- **25**: Redis

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description:
The industry template ID.
> You can call [DescribeDataObjects](~~2399253~~) to obtain the industry template ID.
